Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a mental asylum doctor ordering a schizophrenic patient to take his pills, the patient refuses, and makes him take the pills to prove they are safe. The doctor obliges, but when he opens his eyes, the patient is gone, a figment of his imagination, revealing it was the doctor that was schizophrenic the whole time.  Please use an emoji at the end of every sentence.assistant
response:
INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - DAY 🏥

Dr. Smith, a middle-aged psychiatrist, stands over his patient, Jack, a disheveled young man with sunken eyes, in the dimly lit ward 🤔. Jack's gaze drifts away, lost in thought, as Dr. Smith holds out a small glass of medication 🌊.

DR. SMITH:
"Jack, it's time for your medication. Please take it, it's for your own good 💊."

JACK:
"I don't want it. I don't need it. I'm fine." 🙅‍♂️

DR. SMITH:
"Jack, you're not fine. You're sick. And this medication will help you get better 💪."

JACK:
"I don't believe you. You're just trying to control me." 🚫

DR. SMITH:
"Fine, don't take it. But I'm telling you, it's the only way to get better." 🤷‍♂️

Jack's eyes flash with defiance, and he refuses to take the medication 🚫. Dr. Smith's expression softens, and he takes a step closer to Jack, his voice taking on a gentle tone 🤗.

DR. SMITH:
"Okay, Jack. I'll take it for you. I'll show you it's safe." 💊

Dr. Smith picks up the glass and forces the medication into Jack's mouth 🤢. Jack's eyes widen in protest, but Dr. Smith holds him firm 💪.

CUT TO:

INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - LATER 🕰️

Dr. Smith sits in his office, staring blankly at a file on his desk 📁. He looks up, and his eyes lock onto a photograph of himself and Jack 📸. Suddenly, the room begins to distort and blur, like a painting melting in the rain ☁️.

DR. SMITH:
"Wait... what's going on?" 🤯

The room continues to warp and twist, until Dr. Smith's face is reflected in a shattered mirror, his eyes wild and unhinged 🎭.

DR. SMITH:
"Jack... you're not real, are you?" 😱

The mirror shatters, and Dr. Smith's eyes widen in horror as he realizes the truth: he's the one who's been delusional all along 🤪. Jack, the patient, was just a figment of his imagination, a manifestation of his own fractured mind 💥.

FADE TO BLACK 🌑
